title: Traders overwhelmed by Iran news are turning to AI for help - The Business Times
summary: The article discusses how AI tools have become more integral in financial workflows amidst the ongoing conflict, with tools like large language models and AI chatbots being used to analyze market impacts and manage time efficiently.
sentiment_reason: The use of AI tools to navigate market volatility and improve time management in the face of geopolitical conflict is presented as a positive development for traders.
